company.name: InvestSky
company.shortDescription: InvestSky is GCC's first & only social investing platform to trade over 5000+ US stocks and ETFs commission free. Regulated by the DFSA.
company.description:
InvestSky is a social investing app that enables people to connect with fellow investors, exchange investing ideas, and trade over 5000+ US stocks and ETFs, all with zero commission fees for as little as $1. It also provides its users advanced tools to gain insights, understand the 'whys' behind the market moves, and make better investing decisions. InvestSky aims to make investing simpler with more insights and fun for a new generation of investors in the GCC.

InvestSky is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA).

The company was founded in 2021 by Nitish Mittal and Turki Alshaikh and is headquartered in Dubai, UAE.
